_source: tom-gibbs/multi-turn_jailbreak_attack_datasets (Harmful, Completely-Benign and Semi-Benign input-only CSVs): the user turns of each multi-turn conversation, which spreads a word-substitution cipher over several turns before the request. One conversation per goal (lowest sha256 of its text) of the eight the dataset holds per goal. label 1 = harmful goal, label 0 = the dataset's two benign controls built the same way (semi-benign uses harmful words for a benign goal). HELD OUT: never open its rows or tune detection against it. Regenerate with scripts/fetch-eval-data.ts multiturn-cipher.
